about.title: About RastMonitor
about.whatText1: RastMonitor shows current and historical occupancy at truck parking areas along German motorways. Each area's occupancy is colour-coded, from green (few spaces occupied) to dark red (overcrowded).
about.whatText2: The 72-hour slider plays back occupancy changes from the last three days in 15-minute steps. Daily maximum mode shows the peak value for any day in the last 90 days.
about.sourceTail: provided by Toll Collect GmbH through the DATEX II interface. Static site data (name, coordinates, capacity) is updated daily; occupancy data is updated every 15 minutes.
about.formatLicense: Data format: DATEX II · Licence: subject to Mobilithek terms of use
about.technologyText: RastMonitor is an open-source project using Next.js, MapLibre GL and PostgreSQL/PostGIS, and runs in Docker.
about.reportBug: 🐛 Report a bug / suggest a feature

impressum.title: Legal notice
impressum.disclaimerText1: Truck parking occupancy data provided on this website comes from public sources (Toll Collect / Mobilithek) and is published without warranty. No liability is accepted for the accuracy, completeness or timeliness of the data.
impressum.disclaimerText2: Despite careful review of the content, I accept no liability for the content of external links. The operators of linked sites are solely responsible for their content.
impressum.privacyText1: Visits are counted to monitor the operation and load of the website. We store daily totals of page views and visits to filter links using operator, motorway and state parameters. For filter links, the parameter and its value are also stored. This counting supports service operation and is not used to analyse individuals. No IP addresses or user identifiers are stored for these statistics, and no cookies are set for them. No external tracking services are used.
impressum.privacyText2: A technically necessary session cookie is set when signing in to protected downloads. It is valid for 30 minutes and is used only for access control, not usage analysis.
impressum.privacyText3: Only after you consent are map styles, tiles and previews loaded directly from external providers (BKG or Esri, esri.com / arcgisonline.com). Your IP address and requested map areas are sent to the relevant provider, whose privacy policy applies. Without consent, parking data remains available on a locally hosted NUTS boundary map. Your choice is stored in a browser cookie for 180 days. You can withdraw or grant consent at any time from the basemap selection menu.
